resources.string: This password cannot be read right now. Tap for details and suggestions.
Android requires device authentication before the key can be used. Unlock your device, then unlock Monica and try again.
Android reports that the key is invalidated. Unlocking Monica again may not restore access.
Android could not retrieve the key for this password. This does not confirm that the key has been lost.
The encrypted password failed authentication. The available information cannot distinguish a mismatched key from damaged data.
The read failed, but the exact cause is unknown. Try unlocking Monica again.
This password is unavailable from its database. Check that the database is accessible and unlocked, then reopen the entry.

If you changed OMK (OhMyKeymint), Keybox, or the system key environment, try restoring the configuration used when this password was readable. Then restart the device and unlock Monica. This is a suggestion, not a confirmed cause; recovery is not guaranteed.
The original data is retained. Do not clear app data or uninstall the app.
